The '''Nicht Ka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

It was located along the [[Nache Bhelfia]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], between [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="TEA" />
